name: Symlink publication guard
summary: Prevent commits from publishing symbolic links that escape or ambiguously traverse the repository.
description: A deterministic Claude Code PreToolUse gate for git commit that inspects bounded staged symbolic-link blobs and rejects absolute targets, repository escapes, control characters, or targets whose normalized path cannot be proven contained.
risk_reason: This automatic gate prevents commits from publishing symbolic links that escape or ambiguously traverse the repository; a false denial can interrupt legitimate work, but it does not execute the blocked action.
refuses: It does not create, rewrite, resolve, follow, approve, or remove a symbolic link.
It does not claim that a contained symbolic-link target exists or is safe to consume.
It does not inspect unstaged links or links produced outside the intercepted Git commit path.
It does not expose a repository-controlled exception list or command-line bypass.

entrypoints.purpose: Inspect staged symbolic-link targets before commit and prevent repository-escaping or ambiguous publication.

operational.latency_reason: To prevent commits from publishing symbolic links that escape or ambiguously traverse the repository, the entrypoint may run a bounded local subprocess before returning.
